method: Sequential paired workflows; arm order alternates; baseline's exact fake CLIs; same scratch Git change and default model/effort; ask cold, other turns warm; identical process/fsync tracing; nearest-rank median/p95. Discussion is a third ask-thread turn (reviews are not resumable here). Provider input is text plus separately carried contract/schema bytes; Codex native target-flag reviews carry zero wrapper prompt bytes and read their own diff, excluded from this count, excluding protocol envelopes and unobserved CLI context. No paid calls or tokenizer estimates.
